Name: Elliott Portraits for Seasonal Outfits
Author: craftingace
Description:
I adore the Seasonal Outfits mod, but my favorite boy Elliott got a remake (or, "un"-make"). The mod authors chose to revive El's original concept portrait. I understand if some people prefer the younger Elliott look, but I personally missed the style of his vanilla portrait.

**DISCLAIMER**
I do not own this art. For most of the images, I simply mashed together the SO outfit with the vanilla portrait and just cleaned up the edges.

The only two outfits I drew for are his beach outfit and his Spirit's Eve outfit. 
﻿- I just wanted the beach outfit to remain consistant in the style of vanilla Elliott (and I think he deserves pecs so shhhhh).
﻿- I had to redraw the hat of his Spirit's Eve outfit to fit the scale of the vanilla, but I tried to stay as close to the mod's look as possible. I also re-added his lipstick because it's what he deserves and I like it.

Also, also: I gave him his earring from the og portrait back. It fits his vibe so well.

I probably won't be updating this mod because it's just a little add-in I did for myself but decided to share for those who missed Elliott's look like I did. This is also my first ever mod I'm sharing, so thank you for being understanding <3


TO INSTALL:
﻿- Download Seasonal Outfits and all it's requirements
﻿- Download and Unzip my mod
﻿- Locate the correct folder in you mods folder (>Stardew Valley -> Mods -> [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters -> assets -> Portraits -> Elliott)
﻿ ﻿(NOTE: my mod does nothing for the [-> assets -> Characters -> Elliott] folder. That folder is for sprites only. My mod is specifically for his Portrait)
﻿- Replace the Elliott folder with my mod folder (make sure the name is just "Elliott")
﻿- Enjoy!
